baseline_models.mechanism: The garden is a tree-covered enclosure whose lower watercourse continually supplies yield and shelter; permanence names a maintained habitat, not a frozen inventory.

activation_trace.role: A tree-screened garden literally supplies the enclosing habitat in which the other provisions operate.
Literal streaming supplies continuous movement and makes the habitat self-renewing.
A watercourse cut through earth supplies the channel beneath the garden.
Tree and crop yield supplies the recurring edible output of the habitat.
Literal persistence and settled continuity prevent the yield from entering a depletion cycle.
Shade as shelter, guard, and ease makes protection part of the habitat's output.

changed_reading.before: A static reward scene containing a garden, rivers, fruit, and shade.
changed_reading.after: A continuously maintained protective ecology whose moving water sustains unexhausted nourishment and shelter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَّثَلُ ... وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ... عُقْبَى ... وَعُقْبَى ... ٱلنَّارُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening description and doubled outcome construction place two groups on opposed consequence paths: promised protective flourishing and fire.

activation_trace.role: A descriptive report literally frames the verse as a disclosed condition rather than an ornamental comparison alone.
A spoken commitment opens expectation and makes the garden a guaranteed prospective condition.
Putting oneself in protection identifies the disposition attached to the promised trajectory.
The ending or inherited consequence supplies the repeated hinge that pairs both destinations.
Covering or denying truth identifies the disposition attached to the contrary trajectory.
Literal kindled fire supplies the terminal condition of the second trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The verse appends punishment to a reward description.
changed_reading.after: The verse exhibits two disposition-conditioned trajectories and repeats 'outcome' to make both garden and fire consequences of a course.

baseline_models.mechanism: Flow and permanence are not opposites: water keeps moving while provision remains available, so endurance is a stable process rather than immobility.

activation_trace.role: Literal running contributes ongoing motion to the scene.
An enduring grant of provision lets the running function as sustained supply rather than mere scenery.
Persistence with settledness contributes stable availability across the water's motion.
Recurring yield is the output whose availability does not fail.
Continuous cover supplies the second nondepleting output alongside food.

changed_reading.before: 'Permanent' means that the scene simply lasts forever.
changed_reading.after: Permanence is dynamic reliability: movement continues, but nourishment and cover never lapse.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus repeatedly varies covering: garden and shade cover beneficially, taqwa seeks a shield, kufr covers culpably, and the final fire both burns and emits light. The contrast is therefore protected cover versus truth-covering that ends in exposure, not simply light versus dark.

activation_trace.role: Literal concealment supplies the garden's beneficent enclosure.
A barrier against harm supplies the protective logic of taqwa.
Shadow literally covers from exposure and reinforces beneficent concealment.
Literal covering supplies the opposed act of concealing rather than receiving truth.
Illumination within the fire root makes the terminal fire an exploratory image of forced exposure.
The actual kindled fire keeps that exposure image anchored in the verse's explicit destination.

changed_reading.before: Garden and shade are bright reward imagery, while fire is only dark punishment imagery.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts protective concealment with culpable concealment that culminates in a burning, illuminating exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same running image serves bodies moving toward a named term in 13:2 and rivers paired with lasting yield in 13:35. The repeated motion makes the garden's continuity exceptional rather than generic duration.

activation_trace.role: Literal running carries the celestial bodies along a bounded course and supplies the finite comparator.
A fixed temporal limit terminates that comparator's running.
An enduring provision converts the focus river's running into maintained supply.
Persistence explicitly marks the focus provision as nonexpiring.

structural_cues: 13:2 binds every runner to a named term; 13:35 binds running to lasting produce and shade.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one bounded and one provision-bearing use of running; I infer finite course -> contrastive nondepletion, while the live alternative is that the two motions are merely analogous signs.

changed_reading.before: The rivers are one timeless feature of the garden.
changed_reading.after: Their continued running answers a surah-wide world of courses that normally reach a limit: motion remains, depletion does not.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adjacent plots receive one irrigation source yet produce ranked yields. This sharpens the focus garden from generic abundance into a perfectly sustained transformation of shared water into distinctive nourishment.

activation_trace.role: An allotted irrigation channel literally supplies the distribution mechanism among plots.
Ordinary water supplies the common material input.
Numerical oneness makes that material input shared rather than separately tailored.
Difference in rank supplies the divergent quality of outputs from one input.
Crop yield is the measured output in which differentiation appears.
The focus yield becomes the perfected, continuously available output of that irrigation logic.
Permanence removes the fluctuation that affects ordinary cultivated outputs.

structural_cues: 13:4 sequences adjacent parcels -> one water -> differentiated produce; 13:35 sequences lower rivers -> lasting produce.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared irrigation and unequal yield; I infer input -> transformed output as the focus habitat's causal ecology, while an alternative reads 13:4 only as an independent sign of creative power.

changed_reading.after: It promises an ecology whose common water is unfailingly converted into fitting, differentiated nourishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier exemplary punishments and severe punishment activate the punitive-exemplar branch of the focus opening. Its 'description' can therefore also function as an exhibited consequence meant to redirect conduct.

activation_trace.role: Punitive exempla literally supply consequences made into warnings for others.
Punishment after wrongdoing supplies the causal edge behind those warning examples.
The focus's descriptive report remains the grammatical base while taking on an exemplary function.
Two explicit endings make the displayed garden and fire behaviorally consequential.

structural_cues: 13:6 couples past exempla with severe punishment; 13:35 opens with a description and closes by naming both outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a punitive exemplar and two focus outcomes; I infer displayed consequence -> present admonitory force, while the alternative keeps focus mathal purely descriptive.

changed_reading.before: 'The description of the garden' introduces neutral information.
changed_reading.after: The description is also a live exemplary display: its paired outcomes are shown so the hearer can change course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root of outcome first appears as successive attendants guarding a person, while later every soul's acquisition is tracked and the surah asks whose outcome the home will be. Outcome becomes the accumulated rear edge of a guarded, changeable course.

activation_trace.role: One thing following another literally supplies succession along the person's course.
Guarding and watch supply continuous oversight within that succession.
Acquiring a gain supplies the person's own accumulating contribution to the course.
Repeated acquisition makes the terminal outcome answer to an ongoing history rather than a static label.
The final consequence of the home supplies the explicit terminus of that history.
The focus's doubled endings become two possible termini of an accumulated course.

structural_cues: 13:11 places successive guardians before and behind and then states that change begins within people; 13:42 asks whose outcome the home is.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, guarding, self-change, acquisition, and final outcome; I infer tracked course -> accrued terminus, while the alternative treats the repeated root as loose wordplay without causal continuity.

changed_reading.before: The two outcomes are fixed labels attached to two classes.
changed_reading.after: Each outcome is the trailing consequence of a watched but internally changeable course whose acts accumulate into a home.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failed image of outstretched palms unable to bring water to the mouth makes access, not mere water-presence, decisive. The focus's under-running rivers become provision already routed to its recipients.

activation_trace.role: An extended hand literally supplies effort directed toward inaccessible water.
The palms supply the bodily receptacle that nevertheless cannot secure the provision.
Literal water supplies the desired but unreached object.
Arrival at a goal is explicitly negated and supplies the failed delivery mechanism.
Running beneath the garden supplies a routed, proximate water movement.
A cut watercourse supplies reliable conveyance rather than unreachable standing water.

structural_cues: 13:14's simile denies water-to-mouth arrival; 13:35 locates flowing channels beneath the promised habitat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed reach and proximate channels; I infer routed water -> fulfilled access, while the alternative limits 13:14 to failed invocation with no material contrast.

changed_reading.after: Its water is effective provision: already channeled within reach, in contrast to desired water that never arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Shadows elsewhere participate in submission at morning and evening. The focus shadow can therefore be carried not only as comfort but as an uninterrupted creaturely alignment whose ordinary temporal oscillation has become perpetual shelter.

activation_trace.role: Cast shadow literally supplies the nonhuman participant in the submission scene.
Morning supplies one temporal pole of the shadow's repeated movement.
Late day supplies the other temporal pole of that repeated movement.
The focus shadow retains literal cover while receiving the context's active temporal resonance.
Perpetuity turns morning-evening recurrence into unbroken availability and, exploratorily, unbroken alignment.

structural_cues: 13:15 coordinates shadows with willing or unwilling prostration and marks morning/evening; 13:35 coordinates shade with permanence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies submitting shadows and perpetual focus shade; I infer temporal participation -> uninterrupted alignment, while the live alternative is that the focus shade carries comfort only.

changed_reading.before: Perpetual shade is passive climatic comfort.
changed_reading.after: It can also image shelter continuously aligned with the created order, a strange but text-anchored activation from the submitting shadows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The water/fire parable separates rising foam that departs from benefit that remains. Because the focus again joins example, water, permanence, useful yield, and fire, its two outcomes can be read as the endpoints of a retention filter: sustaining benefit versus consuming exposure.

activation_trace.role: Flood-flow literally supplies the moving carrier in the sorting process.
Floating foam supplies the conspicuous but removable layer.
Kindled fire supplies the second material process that exposes and separates.
A struck parable explicitly classifies the water/fire sequence as an image meant to be transferred.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion for what deserves retention.
Remaining with patient stability supplies the durable result of the filter.
The focus opening invites transfer of the earlier parabolic mechanism into this paired scene.
Lasting yield and shade instantiate the retained side of the process.
Kindled fire instantiates the contrary terminal condition without erasing its literal punitive force.

structural_cues: 13:17 sequences water/fire -> foam -> departure versus benefit -> remaining; 13:35 sequences example -> water -> lasting provision versus fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two tightly matching material constellations; I infer sorting process -> paired durable endpoints, while an alternative treats 13:35 as reward/punishment with no retained-process echo.

changed_reading.before: Garden and fire are two externally assigned destinations.
changed_reading.after: They also render the two termini of a demonstrated filter: what nourishes and remains becomes habitat, while the contrary course ends in fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good outcome is generated by keeping covenant, maintaining connection, patience, entry with repaired kin, open gates, and peace; the bad home follows severance and corruption. The focus garden is therefore a socially connected dwelling, not private consumption.

activation_trace.role: Full completion without deficiency supplies covenant performance as a maintained practice.
A preserved compact supplies the durable relational bond being performed.
Continuing connection and refusing estrangement supply the social mechanism leading toward the good home.
Holding the self against collapse supplies temporal endurance within that mechanism.
The resulting end of the dwelling explicitly names connection's destination.
Literal entry supplies admission of both recipients and arriving messengers into a shared interior.
Multiple entrances supply permeability and welcome rather than isolation.
Safety from harm supplies the social atmosphere announced at arrival.
Severing connection supplies the inverse mechanism leading to the bad home.
Departure from sound order supplies the environmental and social result of severance.
The focus garden becomes the habitat in which the repaired relational network dwells.

structural_cues: Branchless 13:22 د ر ء at word 13 is used only structurally: bad is repelled with good before 'outcome of the home'.
13:23 includes parents, spouses, descendants, and entry through every gate; 13:25 reverses connection into cutting and corruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kept bonds, repaired kinship, entry, peace, and their severing inverse; I infer relational maintenance -> habitable outcome, while an alternative treats these as qualifications for an otherwise individual reward.

changed_reading.before: The promised garden rewards each pious individual with food and shade.
changed_reading.after: It is the durable household-form of maintained connection: repaired generations share entry, peace, provision, and shelter, while severance produces the contrary home.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worldly provision expands and contracts, and worldly life is usable enjoyment that reaches a limit. Lasting produce and shade answer both instabilities: the focus promises reliable sufficiency rather than simply a larger quantity.

activation_trace.role: Expansion and abundance supply one pole of worldly provision's fluctuation.
An allotted gift supplies the worldly distribution being expanded or restricted.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the opposite pole of fluctuation.
Enjoyment extending only to its limit supplies the temporal inadequacy of worldly provision.
A nourishing share supplies the focus's directly available provision.
Persistence removes both contraction and terminal expiry from that share.

structural_cues: 13:26 opposes expansion to restriction and present life to the hereafter; 13:35 foregrounds lasting yield and shade.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies variable allotment and limited enjoyment; I infer volatility/limit -> contrastive reliability, while the alternative hears only a quantitative contrast between little and much.

changed_reading.after: It means provision freed from both scarcity cycles and expiry: dependable sufficiency is the promise's distinctive good.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tranquil hearts supply an interior analogue for the focus's paradox of running water and settled permanence. The garden can image a stable state maintained through ongoing movement, not calm achieved by stopping movement.

activation_trace.role: Literal settling and tranquility supply the interior state to be compared with stable provision.
The heart supplies the interior location in which that settledness occurs.
Repeated recollection supplies the ongoing activity that maintains tranquility.
Continuous running supplies the outer ecology's ongoing activity.
Settled persistence supplies the stable condition produced alongside that activity.

structural_cues: 13:28 repeats tranquility and remembrance; 13:35 juxtaposes running with settled permanence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active remembrance with settled hearts and active flow with lasting provision; I infer repeated activity -> maintained stability, while an alternative keeps the psychological and ecological images separate.

changed_reading.before: Garden movement is external scenery and permanence is only duration.
changed_reading.after: The habitat models dynamic repose: continuous circulation maintains a settled outer and, analogically, inner condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promise is said to arrive without breach after an interval in which deniers are given time, then punishment follows. The focus passive 'was promised' therefore carries appointment-through-delay, and its permanence begins after rather than abolishes temporal waiting.

activation_trace.role: A binding promise supplies certainty despite its not-yet arrival.
An appointed time supplies the promise's bounded point of fulfillment.
Extended time and respite supply the experienced delay before consequence.
Punishment following wrongdoing supplies one realized side of delayed consequence.
The passive focus promise receives the context's certainty-through-waiting.
Lasting provision describes the post-fulfillment condition rather than the waiting interval.

structural_cues: 13:31 says the promise comes and the appointment is not broken; 13:32 inserts respite before seizure; 13:35 uses a passive completed promise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, nonbreach, respite, and consequence; I infer delayed commitment -> certain fulfillment -> lasting state, while an alternative treats the delay material as relevant only to punishment.

changed_reading.before: The promised garden is presented as immediately available timeless fact.
changed_reading.after: It is an appointed fulfillment whose certainty survives delay; once reached, its provision no longer shares the delay-and-expiry pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus and again after it, no protector exists against God; in the focus the promised group is named by self-protective taqwa. The reversal blocks a self-sufficient reading of piety and relocates protection inside the promised divine order.

activation_trace.role: A protector who interposes against harm is explicitly absent and supplies the immediate negative frame.
The repeated absence of a protector confirms that no external shield can oppose divine consequence.
Reflexively placing oneself in protection supplies the recipients' posture, not an independent protector.
A protective shield within the garden root makes the promised habitat itself an image of granted protection.
Shelter, guard, and ease supply the concrete condition into which that posture leads.

structural_cues: 13:34's 'no protector' directly precedes 13:35's muttaqun/ittaqaw pair; 13:37 repeats 'no protector'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied external protection and promised self-protective people; I infer failed autonomous shield -> receptive protective posture -> granted shelter, while an alternative reads only a lexical contrast between sinners and pious people.

changed_reading.before: The pious protect themselves and are rewarded with a protected garden.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa is not leverage or an independent shield; it is the posture associated with entering the only effective protection, represented by enclosure and shade.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every term has an inscribed determination, marks may be erased or established, and present land diminishes; yet judgment admits no reversing reviewer and the final outcome of the home remains. Focus permanence belongs beyond the field of present mutability, not as its endless extension.

activation_trace.role: A fixed temporal limit supplies the boundary governing each present course.
An inscription that establishes decree supplies ordered determination for each limit.
Removal of an effect supplies one side of the mutable record.
Endurance and fixation supply the opposed act of establishing what remains.
Loss of part of a thing supplies visible diminishment in the present land.
The denied reviewer or reverser supplies the irreversibility of judgment despite prior mutability.
The final consequence of the home supplies the settled endpoint after changing records and shrinking land.
Unbroken persistence marks the focus provision as belonging to that settled endpoint.

structural_cues: 13:38-39 moves from term and book to erasure/establishment; 13:41-42 moves from diminishing edges and irreversible judgment to the outcome of the home.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded time, mutable inscription, diminishment, and irreversible outcome; I infer mutable present -> settled judgment -> nondepleting habitat, while an alternative reads these only as separate demonstrations of sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: The hereafter extends ideal earthly resources forever.
changed_reading.after: Its lasting produce and shade mark a categorical transition out of the present order of limits, revision, and diminishment into an irreversible outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mappings of و ع د to preparation/counting and swimming/yearly cycling. It remains anchored at the focus promise and visibly converges with prepared provision, rivers, and permanence, but downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant material echo, never as the lexical derivation of وُعِدَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وُعِدَ at 13:35[4], beside running rivers and lasting yield

activation_trace.role: Prepared stores and equipment literally supply an echo of provision made ready before arrival.
A perennial collected water source supplies a material echo of the garden's nonfailing rivers.
Swimming or current-like motion supplies an echo of water continuously running beneath the habitat.
Alternating annual palm yield supplies a foil whose cycle the focus's lasting yield overcomes.

changed_reading.before: The promise is only a speech act guaranteeing a future garden.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the split-root field lets the promise resonate as provision already prepared, watered, and released from ordinary annual intermittence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the non-dominant ك ل ل mapping inside focus أُكُل beyond ordinary yield. It remains anchored by the verse's joint produce-and-shade construction and the branches of totality and encircling cover, but it should be rendered as a secondary sound/form activation, not as replacement morphology for أُكُل.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness that gathers all parts supplies an exploratory sense of provision without missing components.
An encircling crown, cloud, or flower-ring supplies an exploratory spatial link from yield to surrounding canopy.
An overhead canopy keeps the encircling reading visibly attached to the stated shade.

changed_reading.before: Produce and shade are two separate amenities.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they form complete provision around the inhabitant: nourishment as output and canopy as an encircling whole.

strongest_changes: The 13:17 water/fire filter changes garden and fire from a bare destination pair into retained benefit versus consuming exposure.
The 13:20-25 covenant sequence changes the garden from private reward into a connected, intergenerational home generated by maintained bonds.
The immediate 'no protector' / muttaqun reversal changes taqwa from self-sufficient shielding into a posture associated with granted protection.
Worldly expansion, contraction, limits, erasure, and diminishment make lasting produce dependable and categorically post-mutable rather than merely abundant.
summary.what_was_special: The focus condenses the surah's repeated material grammar: flowing versus expiring courses, one water becoming differentiated yield, foam departing while benefit remains, connection becoming a home, and protection denied outside the order that grants shelter. Split mapped roots also preserve two contained echoes: promise as prepared/perennial provision and yield as complete encircling provision.
remaining_uncertainties: The active-submitting force of perpetual shade is well anchored by 13:15 but may remain only a contextual resonance, not a semantic component of the focus noun.
The covering/exposure axis crosses moral valuations and should not collapse garden, kufr, shade, and fire into one undifferentiated metaphor.
The two split-root outliers are deliberately form-distant and must remain exploratory rather than become lexical claims.
The water/fire retention model is structurally strong, but the direction from the earlier parable to the focus's final destinations remains reader-supplied.
